topic: Bounded Batched Matrix Factor Scoring for 162K Users on Laptop Memory Constraints
problem_statement: Score 162,541 users against 58,932 candidate movies without materializing a dense 10.14-billion cell matrix (which would require >40 GB RAM) on a 16 GB laptop.
root_cause: Cross-joining all users and items in Spark or Python causes immediate Out-Of-Memory driver crashes.
solution_or_decision: Implement bounded batched scoring with batch_size=2,500 using BLAS matrix multiplication (P_batch @ Q.T). In each batch, 2,500 x 58,932 scores (589 MB) are computed in ~0.25s, masked for seen items in 16ms, and Top-K items extracted via 2D argpartition in 1.6s.
evidence: Processed all 162,541 Validation users in 198.03s (throughput 820.8 users/sec) with peak RAM working set < 3.5 GB. Serialized 3,250,820 rows to Parquet (19.38 MB).
